verdict.rationale: ADK's own docs say the framework automatically filters irrelevant events, summarizes older conversational turns, lazy-loads artifacts and tracks token usage, which directly addresses keeping an agent inside its context window. This rests on a single landing-page sentence, with no detail on how a developer configures or controls the behavior. Missing for 10: documented developer-facing configuration or API for trimming, summarization and filtering, explicit history truncation, in-depth reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trim, summarize, or filter conversation history to keep an agent inside its context window

citations.quote: ADK automatically filters irrelevant events, summarizes older conversational turns, lazy-loads artifacts, and tracks token usage.
